bugs_fixed.issue: React infinite loop error: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' when opening dialog
bugs_fixed.root_cause: useEffect dependency on `defaults` prop with default value `{}` created new object on every render
bugs_fixed.fix: Created stable EMPTY_DEFAULTS constant outside component and used it as fallback

critical_code_review_comments: TaskEditorDialog had a common React anti-pattern: default object in function params causes infinite re-renders when used in useEffect deps
All new endpoints properly implemented with correct visibility checks
Sidebar badge polling correctly implemented (60s interval)
Activity tab correctly loads /api/tasks/{id}/history and displays German labels
